I feel so lost.

I’m only 27, and I’m trying to heal from years of trauma while still needing to earn a living. It’s one of the hardest things I’ve ever had to do.

Every time my trauma gets triggered, I shut down. I can’t work, I lose my income, and I end up cancelling classes. It breaks my heart because I genuinely care about my students and hate disappointing them.

I feel trapped between healing and surviving. I don’t know how to balance both anymore, and some days it feels like there’s no hope. I honestly don’t know where to go from here. 😭💔
